tools.name: ask
tools.description: Retrieve relevant passages from this website's published index using NLWeb v0.55. Query and context together are limited to 2000 characters; prefer.limit accepts 1–20 (default 5).

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Use this when a task on minipacs.net is done or abandoned, to tell the site's team how it went: what worked, what was missing or wrong. Returns received: true once stored.
